title: Anhui Flood-Season Emergency UAV Patrol
description:
Anhui Flood-Season Emergency UAV Patrol
To meet power-line safety requirements during the summer flood season, State Grid used our VTOL fixed-wing UAVs to conduct special flood-control emergency patrols across the Chizhou Jiuhua dense power corridor. The operation completed more than 150 sorties, achieved ultra-long-distance transmission of mission signals, and finished the flood-season inspection task on schedule with reliable quality, reinforcing the safety line for power corridors during flood periods.
